name: PPTX Presenter
tagline: Markdown / JSON slide spec to real .pptx binary via pptxgenjs — no API key, no system deps
description: PPTX Presenter renders a Markdown deck or a JSON slide spec into a real PowerPoint .pptx binary file using pptxgenjs (pure JavaScript, no system dependencies, no API key). It supports light/dark themes, 16:9 and 4:3 layouts, section slides, nested bullets, and speaker notes. Use it whenever the deliverable should be a slide deck / presentation / .pptx file. Output is written to disk so the workflow can commit it into artifacts/.
